The top of the tower is observed from the car and, in the process, it takes 10 minutes for the angle of elevation to change from 45° to 60°. After how much more time will this car reach the base of the tower? Choices: A)5(√3 + 1) B)6(√3 + √2) C)7(√3 – 1) D)8(√3 – 2) E)None of these
